faq.q: What do I check in the monthly plan?
faq.a: Checklist, block А: names as per the cost estimate, scope within the balances of the cumulative register, compliance with the project and Г1 changes, realistic schedule, materials as per Е9 norms. Deadline - by the 28th.

faq.q: What to do with an overrun?
faq.a: The line item is excluded from confirmation; the Site Manager receives a written request for explanation (2 business days). A legitimate change - via Г1 the following month; without explanation - not paid, Г9; if the contractor is at fault - Г8.

faq.q: Who is responsible if an overrun is missed?
faq.a: The PTD. The cause is reviewed by the Head of CS.

faq.q: When do I sign certificates?
faq.a: KB-2v - weekly, after verifying the actual scope. Remarks after inspection - no later than 1 business day (Г3).

faq.q: I'm called to close out concealed works - what's the procedure?
faq.a: Inspection BEFORE it's covered by the next works; the call must be made in advance via Worksection. Check the photos (Д4), lab technician's reports (Г7), and certificates - without them the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate is not accepted.

faq.q: When can I stop the works?
faq.a: Safety violations, deviation from the project, missing documentation, poor-quality execution, unapproved materials - a Г4 certificate the same day.

faq.q: How do I initiate a payment?
faq.a: Check the preconditions (contract in the register, cost estimate, acceptance by Technical Supervision), enter the payment in the payment register, assemble the full package for the payment type and submit it to PTD. There is no payment outside the register.

faq.q: A contractor asks 'where's my payment?'
faq.a: Only through you: status request via the Head of Client's Service, response within 2 business days.

faq.q: A client asks to change something - what to do?
faq.a: Client requests do not go directly to the site. Only a Change Request (Г1) with an assessment of the impact on budget and timeline.

faq.q: What are my main deadlines?
faq.a: By 8:30 - headcount to the chat; every Friday by 17:00 - plan vs actual and photo report, by 18:00 - timesheets and delivery notes; by the 25th - the monthly plan (Б1+Б2+В1); by the 5th - the reporting package (Б3).

faq.q: What happens if the plan isn't submitted by the 25th?
faq.a: The following month is not funded and materials are not ordered. This is the most costly mistake of the month.

faq.q: PTD returned the package - what next?
faq.a: You have 2 business days to correct it, then a repeat review takes 2 days. Disputed items may be paid partially - the rest after rework.

faq.q: How do I transfer inventory or machinery under responsibility?
faq.a: Only via certificate В6. Moving machinery between sites - via certificate В4, otherwise logistics costs are not written off.

faq.q: What should I do every day?
faq.a: Maintain the work execution log, make sure the timesheet for each piece of machinery (В5) is filled in every shift, and submit requests for materials (В1) and machinery (В2, В3) in advance.

faq.q: How do I order materials?
faq.a: A В1 request tied to a task from the Б1 plan - no later than the delivery lead time before the need date. Outside the monthly plan - only with justification, and if it involves a change in volumes - a Change Request (Г1) first.

faq.q: I found a problem on site - what should I do?
faq.a: Record it in the daily summary in the Telegram chat. If unplanned work is needed - no 'do it now, paperwork later': the Site Manager first initiates a Change Request (Г1), then the work follows.

faq.q: Why weren't my works accepted?
faq.a: Most often: no entry in the log, no photo documentation (Д4), the Concealed Works Acceptance Certificate isn't closed with reports, or the work was performed outside the plan without Г1.
